name: Kyushu University
description: Kyushu University is a national research university in Fukuoka, founded in 1911 as Kyushu Imperial University. Its main campus is at Ito, on the western edge of the city.
whyIncluded: Kyushu University is among the 10 universities in Japan most chosen by international students (2,618 international students in May 2025, ninth in Japan, per JASSO), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: Kyushu University's own approximate monthly living expenses for international students in Fukuoka: housing with utilities, food, public transport, personal spending, books and health insurance, 12 months a year.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A. Kyushu University International Student Center 'INVITATION' site, Cost & Scholarships page, 'Approximate Living Expenses' per month (undated, read 2026-10-08): housing = 'Housing and Utilities 15,000-50,000' (midpoint 32,500; rent and utilities are not separated; the low end reflects university dormitories); food 30,000; transport = 'Public Transportation 10,000'; personal = personal expenses 20,000 + books and supplies 5,000 + National Health Insurance 2,000 = 27,000. The page's own total is 80,000-115,000. Excluded: Emergency Security Plan 1,000 per year (a one-off student insurance), tuition and set-up costs.

programmes.name: School of Engineering, International Undergraduate Program (Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Civil Engineering, Applied Chemistry)
programmes.summary: Standard national-university tuition, the same for all students. The one-off ¥282,000 is the admission fee, paid once in year 1. Fees may be revised during your studies. Taught in English.
programmes.notes: English-taught programme listed on the International Student Center's degree programmes pages. Kyushu University 'Expenses' page (data as of 1 April 2020, still the published schedule in October 2026): enrollment fee ¥282,000 and tuition ¥535,800/yr (¥267,900 per half year) for undergraduate and graduate school students alike; application fee (¥17,000 undergraduate / ¥30,000 graduate) excluded. National-university fees may be revised during enrolment, so not cohort-locked. No year-specific 2024 or 2025 fee publication read, so no history.
